name: Canaan
overview: Scripture reveals Canaan as both a person and a place of profound significance in God's redemptive plan. As the son of Ham and ancestor to various peoples, Canaan's lineage is foundational (Genesis 9:18; 10:6,15). The land of Canaan, to which God called Abram from Ur, is presented as the promised inheritance for Abraham and his descendants, a land divinely designated and central to the unfolding covenant (Genesis 11:31; 12:1). This land, known by many sacred names including the Land of Promise and the Holy Land, is integral to God's purpose and the history of His people.
